subject: S10 scheduling: previews use ts-fsrs 6.0.0 FSRS-6 maths with the server's (py-fsrs 6.3.3) scheduler policy — accepted deviation from the brief
body: Reviewer verified: memory model identical; ts-fsrs vs py-fsrs differ only in scheduler policy (UTC-day diff, monotonic intervals, Hard on later steps, sMax cap, fuzz clamp); server (py-fsrs) is authoritative, so the preview follows it. Seeded fuzz ported; golden file + 454k randomized reviews; both libraries pinned exactly, any upgrade fails the golden tests.
